title: tracker
description: Assigns persistent track ids to detection events and republishes them as tracked_detection events.

iou_threshold.description: Minimum box overlap (IoU) to match a detection to an existing track.

max_age.description: Frames a track survives without a matching detection before it is dropped.

min_hits.description: Matched detections a track needs before its id is reported.

class_gated.description: Only match detections to tracks of the same class.

appearance_threshold.description: Minimum embedding similarity for an appearance match; 0 turns appearance matching off.

appearance_weight.description: Weight of appearance similarity in the match cost when appearance matching is on.

embed_alpha.description: Smoothing factor for updating a track's stored appearance embedding.

det_high_thresh.description: Confidence splitting high and low detections for two-stage matching; 0 uses a single stage.

low_iou_threshold.description: Minimum IoU for matching low-confidence detections in the second stage.

ocm_weight.description: Weight of the direction-consistency term in the match cost.
